name: ONLYOFFICE
summary: Office editor suite for compatible file and content apps.

catalog.description: ONLYOFFICE provides document, spreadsheet, and presentation editing that compatible MOS file apps can connect to for browser-based office workflows.

features.title: Browser office editing
features.body: Connect a compatible file app so documents, spreadsheets, and presentations open in the browser editor.

features.title: Independent service
features.body: Install and run the office editor separately from the file app that stores documents.

complexity.label: Integration service
complexity.description: ONLYOFFICE is useful after it is connected to a compatible document platform.

resourceHint.label: High resources
resourceHint.description: Document Server is heavier than small utility packages and may take several minutes to start cold.

privacy.summary: Documents remain in the connected file app; ONLYOFFICE receives editing callbacks and temporary document data.
notes: MOS generates a stable JWT secret so integrations keep working across restarts.
Connect this package to a compatible file app before expecting a normal user workflow.

usefulness.emptyState: Install a compatible file app such as Seafile, then connect it to ONLYOFFICE.
